requirement: Map a create-pathogen command to a new Pathogen model: copy the name, description, and atypical flag, let the entity generate its id, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Command with a pathogen name, description, and atypical flag

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new Pathogen
Name, description, and atypical flag are copied and an id is generated

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
